A SMALL GUIDE

Listen. The meadow is breathing.

Drop or choose a local MP4 or audio file, then press Play.

  • Louder sound creates larger points; softer sound creates smaller points.
  • Denser note onsets increase movement speed. Sparse or sustained sound lets it settle.
  • Drag or use arrow keys to explore. Scroll to move closer. Press R to reset.
  • Press Space to play or pause. Response settings adjust sensitivity and movement.

Rhythm is estimated live and may take several seconds to adapt to complex or legato music. Files remain in this browser and must be selected again after a reload.
